title: His first and only marijuana experience at the Saratoga Club
summary: Armstrong gave him a reefer at the Saratoga Club; he smoked two and was high through a broadcast.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: How about the song that you recorded with Louis Armstrong's band, 'Song of the Vipers'? Isn't that about pot smoking?
(He gave me ?) the first reefer ever I smoked. I smoked two; never do it again.
You smoked two, one right behind the other?
With Red Allen, Saratoga Club, he came in from Chicago. It was cold, so -
Anybody want a cup of coffee or something?
No thanks. We're wrapping it up.

We're about through now so we could stand a little coffee... So we had a floor show down there too. Boy, it was jumping, Saratoga Club. So Louis came in and he sat in with us from Chicago. So everybody knew he smoked, so I said, "Give me a puff." He said, "It don't take but five." So I smoked five. I smoked the whole thing. I didn't feel nothing - then. So we had to broadcast that night. I said, "Give me another one." I smoked a whole one. So the time came to broadcast. I had the first solo. I don't remember playing nothing yet, the only thing I was just walking on a cloud, man... That's true. You know if you're drinking and get high and you go out in the fresh air, you sober up. Cats (...) gave me a steak and I ate it and it didn't

do no good. Went upstairs and stood out in the cold - no good. They brought me a pork chop down. That didn't do no good. I didn't do nothing but laugh. I didn't get straight until 1 o'clock the next day. I said, no more.
I didn't have no feeling. Just as light, just like walking on cotton, just feel nothing.
